proposal: Heat input from the measured composition per ISO 6976 in all tests; the consortium asks the Owner to correct ER-03.02 / DP-CASE-0018 to 47.48 MJ/kg.
question: IEC-ALP-PER-001 uses LHV 47.48 MJ/kg calculated per ISO 6976 from the Owner reference composition; the Owner contract (ER-03.02, DP-CASE-0018) states 48.4 MJ/kg for the same composition. The EPC confirms 47.48 MJ/kg (34.78 MJ/Sm3). Please confirm that the IEC guarantees are on heat input = fuel mass flow x LHV of the actual test gas (on-line chromatograph, ISO 6976) and are therefore independent of the 48.4 MJ/kg figure.
response: Confirmed: the IEC guarantees are on heat input = fuel mass flow x LHV of the test gas per ISO 6976 from the on-line chromatograph; 47.48 MJ/kg is correct for the reference composition. IEC supports the correction of ER-03.02 by the Owner.
subject: Fuel LHV basis of the IEC performance
